headline: Search lead value slipped; $5,390 NP, a normal Monday after an unusually good one
commentary:
### The day
- NP $5,390 at 10.8%, less than half of last Monday's haul.
  - NP: $5,390 v $12,044 last Mon
  - NM: 10.8% v 22.1%
- Against the last eight Mondays that's bang on average — last week was the outlier.
  - 8-week Monday NP mean: $5,807
  - Monday range: $2,324 to $12,044
- **November still comfortably ahead of October** on the same days.
  - MTD NP: $64,838 v $50,506
  - MTD NM: 17.2% v 14.2%
### What drove it
- Volume turned up, value didn't. We bought more leads for less each.
  - Processed: 3,199 v 2,869
  - EPL: $15.61 v $18.99
- **Search is the whole story**: same clicks, cheaper, thinner leads.
  - Search NP: $2,329 v $7,909 last Mon
  - Search EPL: $26.18 v $29.22
  - Search CPC: $11.55 v $11.82
- Softness sits across both big trees, which looks like ordinary lumpiness.
  - Direct (Inc ZP) EPL: $19.17 v $20.91 last 7
  - Test Ping Tree EPL: $18.01 v $19.95
- PMAX nearly tripled and paid for itself; Bing drifted back.
  - PMAX cost: $2,963 v $1,153
  - PMAX EPL: $9.87 v $7.67
  - Bing EPL: $13.65 v $15.52
### Tests
| Test | Set-up | Spend 09/11 | Spend wk ago | Change |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| personal | ROAS target, cut 25/09 | $399 | $200 | — |
| competitor | ROAS target, cut 25/09 | $1,341 | $1,096 | — |
| speed | being walked down | $1,858 | $1,243 | — |
| scavengers (comp + amount) | low-CPC skim | $1,461 | $1,169 | — |
- Speed took more spend while our top-of-page share there went under 10%.
  - speed cost: $1,858 v $1,243
- Scavengers keep nibbling cheap clicks at a third of Search CPC.
  - amount_scavenger IS: 13.8% v 10.6%
watch: Search EPL over the next few days against the $25.93 month-to-date line, to see whether Monday was just a lumpy day.
PMAX at its new spend level, and whether $9.87 EPL holds as it scales.
albert.com, down 7.5 points of impression share across the account, and whether that makes the auctions cheaper for us.
